title: HACHETTE JOB - Rippaverse, Racism, DEI and Cancel Culture Wars EXPOSED
description:
Commi3 Mark your friendly neighbourhood communist coming at you once again from deep within the Soviet Jazz Club for another emergency session of the Russian Troll Factory.

This week comrades… we need to talk about Hachette.

Because Rippaverse just made a HUGE move in the comic industry and partnered with one of the biggest publishing companies on Earth… and the deeper I dug into this thing the stranger it got.

Who ARE Hachette?
Why are they so powerful?
Why do they seem to pop up in every corner of publishing history?
And why does this rabbit hole somehow lead us through comic industry politics, cancel culture wars, censorship drama, colonial-era publishing, corporate media power, DEI initiatives, French political chaos and some VERY weird historical receipts?

Tonight we investigate:

* Rippaverse and the Hachette deal
* comic publishing politics
* culture war propaganda
* legacy media institutions
* corporate publishing influence
* censorship controversies
* DEI and modern publishing
* old French educational propaganda
* railway monopolies
* cancel culture battles
* media power structures
* and the long march of the publishing bourgeoisie through history.

Was Hachette a revolutionary outsider company crushed by reactionary elites?
Or did it slowly evolve into a gigantic institutional machine plugged directly into the arteries of global culture?

BASED or EVIL?
The Communist Super AI will decide.
